title: Fix Duplicate Top-Level Declarations in Sketchpad.tsx
description: Fix duplicate top-level declarations in Sketchpad.tsx that cause Babel parser errors: AppMachineContext, AppMachineInput, AppTransactionState, SketchpadState, Synchronizable, TutorialContext
summary: Fixed 6 duplicate top-level declarations in Sketchpad.tsx: (1) Synchronizable — removed identical second copy; (2) AppTransactionState — removed identical second copy; (3) AppMachineInput — renamed legacy version to LegacyAppMachineInput; (4) AppMachineContext — renamed legacy version to LegacyAppMachineContext; (5) SketchpadState$ — removed unused dead type alias (false positive); (6) TutorialContext interface — renamed to TutorialMachineContext, updated reference in SketchpadContext.
